title: Four brands. Four apps
captions:
Different logger. Different software. No comparison.

AiM, Unipro, Alfano and Starlane each come with their own desktop software, and each one only reads its own files. If your teammate runs a different brand, your data never meets.

That is about to change. Coming soon to Kart Connect.

#karting #datalogging #kartracing

Ever tried to compare your data with a teammate on a different logger?

Something one of a kind is coming to Kart Connect. Every major logger brand, one screen.

kart-connect.com

#karting #kartsetup #motorsport

AiM. Unipro. Alfano. Starlane. Four brands, four apps, no way to compare.

If you and your teammate run different loggers, your data has never been on the same screen. We are changing that.

Coming soon to Kart Connect.

#karting #datalogging #motorsport

title: Every logger, one screen
captions:
Every major logger brand. One screen.

Drop in CSVs from AiM, Unipro, Alfano or Starlane and overlay them: speed, braking, acceleration, throttle, RPM and GPS racing lines, brand against brand. See exactly where a teammate brakes later, gets on the power sooner, or carries more speed through a corner.

Coming soon to Kart Connect.

#karting #datalogging #kartracing

Your teammate runs a different logger. It no longer matters.

Speed traces, braking points, throttle, RPM and racing lines from every major logger brand, overlaid on one screen. Lap tables and sector analysis included.

Coming soon. kart-connect.com

#karting #kartsetup #motorsport

Drop in a CSV from any major logger brand and Kart Connect does the rest.

Lap times ranked, speed traces overlaid, racing lines drawn from GPS and colour-coded slow to fast, and every lap split into sectors so you can see exactly where the time goes.

Coming soon. kart-connect.com

#karting #kartracing #datalogging

title: Watch the lap. See the delta
captions:
Watch the lap. See the delta.

Load onboard footage for two drivers and watch them side by side, frame-accurate. A live delta shows who is ahead and by how much, while you see exactly where each driver brakes and gets back on the power. GoPro Hero 7 to 12 lines up automatically from GPS; DJI Osmo Action 3, 4 and 5 sync through the .srt file.

Coming soon to Kart Connect.

#karting #datalogging #gopro

See the gap. Then see why.

Side-by-side onboard video with a live delta, braking and acceleration playing along with the footage. No manual trimming.

Coming soon. kart-connect.com

#karting #kartracing #motorsport

Two onboards. One timeline.

Watch any two drivers side by side with a live delta, and see who brakes later and who is back on the power first, frame by frame. Works with GoPro Hero 7 to 12 and DJI Osmo Action 3, 4 and 5.

Coming soon to Kart Connect.

#karting #onboard #motorsport

title: Your perfect lap
captions:
What does your perfect lap look like?

Kart Connect takes your fastest Sector 1, Sector 2 and Sector 3, from any lap and even across sessions, and combines them into your theoretical best. Then sector analysis shows where the time is.

Coming soon.

#karting #datalogging #kartracing

Your best lap is already in your data. It is just split across three laps.

Theoretical best lap and sector analysis, coming soon to the Kart Connect Data Logger.

kart-connect.com

#karting #kartsetup #motorsport

Fastest Sector 1. Fastest Sector 2. Fastest Sector 3. Put them together and that is your theoretical best.

Kart Connect builds it for you, even across sessions, and shows which sector is costing you.

Coming soon. kart-connect.com
